week.name: Today
week.short: Partly Sunny then Slight Chance Light Rain
week.detailed: A slight chance of rain after noon. Partly sunny. High near 63, with temperatures falling to around 59 in the afternoon. South southeast wind 2 to 6 mph. Chance of precipitation is 20%.

week.name: Saturday
week.short: Light Rain Likely then Chance Showers And Thunderstorms
week.detailed: Rain likely before noon, then a chance of showers and thunderstorms. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 57. South wind around 3 mph. Chance of precipitation is 60%.

week.short: Light Rain then Showers And Thunderstorms
week.detailed: Rain before 5pm, then showers and thunderstorms. Cloudy, with a high near 50. South southeast wind around 3 mph. Chance of precipitation is 100%. New rainfall amounts between three quarters and one inch possible.
